GENERAL.BACKGROUND_PLAY_DESC: Keep playing audio after switching to background (listen to TV); mutually exclusive with Picture-in-Picture
GENERAL.CACHE_PATH_EXTERNAL_DESC: Move the cache directory to external storage. Requires all-files access; takes effect after restart

PLAYER.FORCE_SOFT_DECODE_DESC: Force software decoding for video playback
PLAYER.MEDIA3_SOFT_DECODE_AUDIO_ONLY_DESC:
Only applies to the Media3 core: forced software decoding affects audio only, video remains hardware-decoded;
IJK/VLC always decode audio with ffmpeg, so this switch is not needed for them
PLAYER.SUPER_RESOLUTION_DESC: Choose a real-time super-resolution path: GPU spatial enhancement, the Anime4K shader, an FSR/CAS-style GPU path, an online AI Lite model, or the Real-ESRGAN Vulkan runtime. QuickOP opens a selection panel for this setting.
PLAYER.FRAME_INTERPOLATION_DESC: Choose a real-time interpolation path: GPU frame blending or the RIFE Vulkan runtime creates intermediate display frames after decoding during playback. QuickOP opens a selection panel for this setting.
PLAYER.INTERPOLATION_TARGET_FPS_DESC: Request a target refresh rate for the enhancement output Surface; actual output depends on display refresh, source cadence, and processing capacity.
PLAYER.AI_EXECUTION_BACKEND_DESC: Choose automatic selection, NNAPI device acceleration, or CPU execution for AI Lite.
PLAYER.FIT_FRAME_RATE_DESC: Match display refresh rate to video frame rate
PLAYER.FRAME_RATE_FALLBACK_DESC: Used only when frame-rate fit is enabled and no valid field rate or frame rate is detected. “System default” does not use a fallback refresh rate.
PLAYER.BETTER_DETECTION_DESC:
When enabled, the player will attempt to more accurately detect video formats, which may increase startup time.
For Media3, the player will support TS files missing AUD and IDR, and disable HLS without chunk preparation.
For IJK, the player will increase detection size and analysis duration, and enable loop filtering and precise seeking.
PLAYER.EXTRACT_HEADER_FROM_LINK_DESC: Extract HTTP headers from stream URL
PLAYER.LOAD_TIMEOUT_DESC: Affects source switching and reconnection on timeout
PLAYER.BUFFER_TIME_DESC:
For Media3 and VLC, it is minimum buffer load time before playback (seconds);
 For Ijk, it is minimum buffer load frames (f) before playback
PLAYER.STALL_RETRY_DESC: Automatically retry the current line when the playback position stops advancing; off by default
PLAYER.DECODER_CONFIG_DESC: Changing options clears existing memory settings
PLAYER.VOLUME_BALANCE_LEVEL_DESC: When enabled, playback volume will be balanced to solve inconsistent volume in subscription sources; only supported by Media3 player
PLAYER.ASR_REAL_TIME_DESC: Real-time speech recognition to generate subtitles from audio; supports Media3 and IJK players
PLAYER.ASR_MODEL_DESC: Select speech recognition model (not yet implemented, coming soon)
PLAYER.ASR_MODE_DESC: Pre-decodes audio from HLS / HTTP streams so subtitles can appear before dialogue playback. Other protocols such as RTSP fall back automatically.
PLAYER.ASR_LEAD_TIME_DESC: Only affects experimental leading subtitles; shifts subtitle lookup ahead of playback position
PLAYER.ASR_SILENCE_THRESHOLD_DESC: How long of silence triggers sentence break after speech. Lower values make it more sensitive but may break on short pauses; higher values keep subtitles flowing but delay breaks after pauses.
PLAYER.ASR_VAD_TYPE_DESC: Voice activity detection backend (TenVad is more accurate for mixed Chinese/English or low SNR)
PLAYER.ASR_AUTO_STREAMING_FALLBACK: Prefer streaming model outside ahead mode
PLAYER.ASR_AUTO_STREAMING_FALLBACK_DESC: When active HLS ahead decoding is unavailable or fails, prefer an already-downloaded streaming ASR model to reduce subtitle latency. Models are not downloaded during playback.
PLAYER.ASR_GEMINI_API_KEY_DESC: Obtain from Google AI Studio; stored locally only, never cloud-synced
PLAYER.ASR_GEMINI_ENDPOINT_DESC: Leave blank to use the official default endpoint
PLAYER.ASR_TRANSLATION_ENGINE_DESC: Translate ASR results to target language
PLAYER.AUDIO_SCREENSAVER_DESC: Hide the picture on audio-only channels (radio) and keep playing audio
PLAYER.KEEP_LAST_FRAME_DESC: Keep the last frame on screen after playback stops instead of showing black
PLAYER.AAC_PREFER_DESC: Prefer the AAC audio track, useful on devices where AAC hardware decoding is more stable
PLAYER.IJK_ANALYZEDURATION_DESC: analyzeduration in microseconds; too small may fail to detect the video format
PLAYER.IJK_PROBESIZE_DESC: probesize in bytes; too small may fail to start playback
PLAYER.IJK_CACHE_MS_DESC: In milliseconds; -1 disables it (use the player default cache policy)
PLAYER.IJK_AUDIO_SOFT_DESC: Force audio through FFmpeg software decoding, for devices with broken audio hardware decoding
PLAYER.EXO_TUNNELED_DESC: Tunneled playback reduces power and latency; may cause artifacts or no audio on some devices
PLAYER.EXO_BUFFER_PLAYBACK_MS_DESC: Minimum buffer required before playback starts, in milliseconds
PLAYER.EXO_BUFFER_REBUFFER_MS_DESC: Buffer target after a rebuffer, in milliseconds; -1 disables it

SYNC.TITLE: Cloud Sync
SYNC.BACKUP_ENABLE_DESC: Allow system to backup app data (settings, favorites, etc.), restorable when switching devices

UI.SHOW_EPG_PROGRAMME_PROGRESS_DESC: Show current program progress bar at the bottom of the channel
UI.SHOW_EPG_PROGRAMME_PERMANENT_PROGRESS_DE: Show current program progress bar at the bottom of the player
UI.SHOW_REPLAY_BADGE_DESC: Display replay icon on channels that support replay
UI.CHANNEL_PREVIEW_PARALLEL_COUNT_DESC: Number of channel preview first-frames fetched in parallel; too high may cause network lag
UI.LIST_ANIMATION_DESC: Transition animation when the channel list is reordered
UI.LAZY_RENDER_DESC: When on, preview frame fetching is throttled in batches by interval to reduce network/decode spikes during scrolling
UI.USE_CLASSIC_PANEL_SCREEN_DESC: Interface style similar to traditional TV
UI.CLASSIC_SHOW_SOURCE_LIST_DESC: Show source list on the left in classic mode
UI.CLASSIC_SHOW_CHANNEL_INFO_DESC: Show detailed channel info in classic mode
UI.CLASSIC_SHOW_CHANNEL_NO_DESC: Display channel number separately in classic mode
UI.CLASSIC_SHOW_ALL_CHANNELS_DESC: Show all channels list in classic mode

EPG.ENABLE_DESC: May be slow on first load
EPG.ALWAYS_SHOW_IN_CLASSIC: Always show EPG in classic channel screen
EPG.ALWAYS_SHOW_IN_CLASSIC_DESC: If enabled, the classic channel screen will always display the EPG.
EPG.FOLLOW_SOURCE_DESC: Prioritize EPG defined in subscription source
EPG.LOAD_ALL_DESC: When enabled, the app will load all custom EPGs. This may cause memory overflow, long loading times, and loading failures.
EPG.REFRESH_THRESHOLD_DESC: EPG will not refresh before {{time}} every day
EPG.REFRESH_THRESHOLD_ALWAYS_DESC: EPG will be refreshed every time the app starts
EPG.TIME_ZONE_OFFSET_HINT: Time zone of the programme times, -12 to 12

SUBSCRIBE.ENCRYPTED_GROUP_DESC: When a channel group name ends with _number, it is hidden from search and all channels by default. When switching to this category in the channel selection screen, a password prompt appears (the number after _).
SUBSCRIBE.EPG_URL_HINT: Used first when EPG is set to follow the source
SUBSCRIBE.AUTO_REFRESH_HINT: 0 = Off; silently refreshes the current source at this interval
SUBSCRIBE.GROUP_PARS_STYLE_DESC: How groups are nested in the channel picker
SUBSCRIBE.CHANNEL_NO_ABBREV_DESC: Use a shortened form when the channel number is too long
SUBSCRIBE.CHANNEL_LOGO_INITIAL_DESC: Generate a logo from the channel name initial when no logo is available
SUBSCRIBE.M3U_LOGO_PRIORITY_DESC: tvg-logo from the m3u source takes precedence over the logo from the EPG source
SUBSCRIBE.GROUP_CONFIG_ENABLE_DESC: Allow per-group player parameters in m3u via #genre#,#EXTKU9OPT:
SUBSCRIBE.FILE_CONTENT_OUT_OF_SANDBOX: Only files inside the TV file / cache directory can be read. For other paths use the Files page to upload.
